ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-style crust, golden-brown edges with darker charred spots, topped with a layer of melted white cheese partly browned in places, scattered red-brown sauce and small bits of green vegetable and brownish meat pieces; sits on the upper right of the plate, about 7 cm long by 5 cm wide, roughly 1 cm thick, with moist, slightly glossy cheese surface and firm crust edge | 75

ITEM 2 | Irregular rectangular chunk with golden-brown, slightly crisp outer surface and a grainy, crumbly interior of tan and pale yellow bits, with some darker brown patches; lies lower left on the plate, about 3 cm by 2.5 cm and 1 cm thick, dry-looking and holds its shape | 14

ITEM 3 | Small crumbled fragment of the same golden-brown, grainy material, irregular edges, pale yellow and brown, about 1.5 cm across, lies beside item 2 on the plate, dry and crumbly | 5

ITEM 4 | Scattered tiny crumbs of golden-brown and pale material, each under 0.5 cm, spread across the lower centre and right of the plate, dry and loose | 2
